review_candidates.title: Head of IT & Media Technology (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Als Head of IT & Media Technology (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die technologische Zukunft eines modernen Medienunternehmens und verantwortest die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur, Medientechnologie und Streaming-Technologie. In dieser zentralen Führungsposition verbindest Du klassische Aufgaben eines IT-Leiters mit den Anforderungen moderner TV- und Broadcast-Technik und entwickelst eine zukunftsfähige IT-Strategie für unseren Standort in Ismaning bei München. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team treibst Du die digitale Transformation, Cloud-Technologien und automatisierte Infrastrukturprozesse voran. Dabei setzt Du unter anderem auf Microsoft Azure, AWS, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, PowerShell und GitLab. Du etablierst effiziente ITSM-Prozesse nach ITIL, steuerst anspruchsvolle IT-Projekte und stellst eine sichere, stabile und leistungsfähige technische Umgebung für unsere Live-, Streaming- und Broadcast-Systeme sicher. review_candidates.title: Senior Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description ERA Solutions is an automation company specializing in smart homes, smart buildings, and smart hotels. The organization focuses on delivering integrated, innovative solutions that enhance comfort, security, and energy efficiency for its clients. ERA Solutions works closely with property developers, businesses, and individual customers to design and implement scalable automation systems. The company values technical excellence, reliable service, and long-term partnerships, offering growth opportunities for professionals interested in building automation and smart technologies. Role Description The Senior Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in New Cairo, responsible for driving sales of automation solutions for smart homes, smart buildings, and smart hotels. This role includes meeting with prospects and customers, understanding their technical and business requirements, and designing suitable automation solutions in collaboration with the engineering team. The Senior Sales Engineer will prepare and deliver technical presentations, respond to RFPs and proposals, and support the sales cycle from initial contact through closing. Daily tasks involve providing pre- and post-sales technical support, coordinating with project and technical teams, and maintaining strong customer relationships to ensure satisfaction and repeat business. The role also includes market research, participation in industry events, and contributing to sales forecasts and strategic planning. Qualifications Demonstrated proficiency in Sales Engineering and technical solution design for automation or related technologies. Strong Sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and closing. Experience in Technical Support and troubleshooting to assist customers before and after implementation. Excellent Communication and Customer Service skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. Background in electrical engineering, electronics, control systems, or a related technical field; bachelor’s degree preferred. Proven experience in building automation, smart homes, smart buildings, or hospitality technology is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in New Cairo, manage multiple opportunities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong presentation, documentation, and CRM usage skills, with a focus on accuracy and follow-through.

review_candidates.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer
review_candidates.description: We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Web Developer who owns the web platform end-to-end — from crafting pixel-perfect, high-performance front-end interfaces to designing robust, scalable server-side systems. This is a web-focused role: you live in the browser as much as the backend, and you care deeply about load times, accessibility, SEO, and the experience users actually have when they open their browser. What You'll Own Architect and build high-performance web applications with a focus on Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), and SEO best practices. Lead front-end architecture decisions — component design systems, rendering strategies, state management, and bundle optimization. Design and implement scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs that power both the web platform and future client integrations. Own the full web delivery pipeline — from local development to staging, CDN configuration, and production deployment. Drive web performance improvements: code splitting, lazy loading, caching strategies, and image optimization. Establish and enforce front-end standards: testing coverage, accessibility audits, code review practices, and documentation. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement interfaces that are both visually faithful and technically sound. Mentor junior and mid-level web developers and elevate the team's overall craft. Requirements 6+ years of professional experience building and shipping web applications — specifically targeting browsers, not native platforms. Expert-level React and TypeScript skills, including advanced patterns like compound components, render props, and custom hooks. Deep familiarity with Next.js rendering modes (SSR, SSG, ISR) and when to apply each. Strong backend proficiency: building APIs, managing authentication flows, and designing data models. Proven track record optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) in production web applications. Solid understanding of browser internals — the critical rendering path, event loop, memory management, and caching mechanisms. Experience with relational databases, query optimization, and writing migrations safely in live environments. Accessibility-first mindset: ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and WCAG compliance. Demonstrated leadership experience — driving architecture decisions, mentoring others, and shaping team standards. Strong Plus Experience building and maintaining a component design system used across multiple teams or products. Familiarity with micro-frontend architecture and module federation. Knowledge of web security — CORS, CSP headers, XSS/CSRF prevention, and OAuth flows. Experience with internationalization (i18n) and multi-locale web deployments. Open-source contributions or published technical writing related to web development.
